en.t: The waves along the shore surged and roared violently.

units.source_text: 波涛翻腾溅起浪花的时候，雨点不断地扎进不平静的海面。

en.t: As the waves churned and threw up spray, raindrops kept stabbing into the restless surface of the sea.

units.source_text: 无光的雨，只是冷静地刺穿非同寻常的海面。

en.t: The lightless rain merely pierced the extraordinary sea surface with cold composure.

units.source_text: 但是，海风突然把雨刮到荒凉的岩壁上。

en.t: But the sea wind suddenly drove the rain against the desolate rock wall.

units.source_text: 洁白的岩壁被染黑了，似是喷上了一层墨汁。

en.t: The pure white rock wall was stained black, as if a layer of ink had been sprayed over it.
